  html_document:
    theme: null
    highlight: null

params:

---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
report <- params$report
```

## Parameters

```{r parameters}
if (is.null(report$parameters)) {
  cat("No parameters file provided.\n")
} else {
  knitr::kable(report$parameters, col.names = c("Parameter", "Value"))
}

if (!is.null(report$revision_text) && nzchar(report$revision_text)) {
  cat("\n\n### Ampliseq revision\n\n```\n")
  cat(report$revision_text)
  cat("\n```\n")
}
```

## Unmatched WoRMS names

ASVs with at least one rank assigned but no `scientificNameID`. Unique query names (finest filled rank):

```{r unmatched}
cat(report$unmatched_summary, "\n\n")
if (nrow(report$unmatched) == 0) {
  cat("None.\n")
} else {
  knitr::kable(report$unmatched)
}
```

## SINTAX vs VSEARCH name agreement

Per-rank comparison on shared `ASV_ID`s (case-insensitive).

```{r agreement}
knitr::kable(report$agreement)
cat("\n", report$finest_summary, "\n", sep = "")
```
